verdict.rationale: Simular is a computer-use agent, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair axis for it. The pack shows no evidence that users can plug MCP servers into Sai. The only MCP evidence is the `@simular-ai/sai-mcp` server, which lets other coding agents drive Sai; that is the opposite (server) role. Skills and replayable workflows are adjacent extension features, not MCP client support.
